title: Brazilian Chorizo Italian Casserole
description: A hearty Italian-inspired casserole featuring spicy Brazilian chorizo and a hint of quaint, fluffy texture.
instructions: Cook chorizo sausage in a pan over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Remove cooked chorizo from pan and set aside.
Add olive oil to the pan and sauté diced onion and minced garlic until softened.
Stir in Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper.
In a large mixing bowl, combine cooked chorizo, onion mixture, and quaint fluffy breadcrumbs.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
